title: Heat Fragmented Genomic DNA for Illumina Library Preparation
author: Marie-Ka Tilak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jxicpke
materials: 3/ Denaturized fragmented DNA Preheat thermocycler to 90°C and heat the tube for 5 min. Without allowing the tube to cool, add 90ul (ratio volume fragmented DNA / volume beads was 1,8) Agencourt beads for sizing fragmented genomic DNA following Illumina library protocol. Elute in 32ul of ultra pure water. Be careful : at this step, the loss of DNA is about 60%. To obtain a higher amount of DNA, use several 500 ng samples rather than one of 1µg. Indeed, denaturation at 90 ° C is less effective with larger amounts of DNA

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Shear DNA to 200‑500 bp
steps.instruction: Shear 500 ng (10 ng/µl) of the extracted genomic DNA in a 0.2 ml tube using an ultrasonic cleaning unit; add 250 ml of 4 °C sterilized water, and run for 20 min.

substeps.instruction: Place 500 ng (10 ng/µl) of extracted genomic DNA into a 0.2 ml tube.
Add 250 ml of 4 °C sterilized water to the tube.
Shear the mixture with the ultrasonic cleaning unit for 20 min.

steps.title: Blunt‑end repair
steps.instruction: Prepare master mix for the required number of samples, add 8 µl master mix to each sample, mix gently by pipetting, incubate 15 min at 25 °C followed by 5 min at 12 °C, clean with 64 µl AMPure XP beads per tube as per manufacturer’s instructions, and elute in 32 µl ultra‑pure water.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the blunt‑end repair master mix for all samples.
Add 8 µl of master mix to each sample and mix gently.
Incubate 15 min at 25 °C, then 5 min at 12 °C.
Add 64 µl AMPure XP beads to each tube and follow the bead‑cleanup protocol.
Elute the cleaned DNA in 32 µl ultra‑pure water.

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Prepare adapter ligation master mix, add 6 µl master mix to each sample, mix gently, incubate at 16 °C overnight, clean with 64 µl AMPure XP beads per tube as per manufacturer’s instructions, and elute in 34 µl ultra‑pure water.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the adapter ligation master mix for all samples.
Add 6 µl of master mix to each sample and mix gently.
Incubate the reaction at 16 °C overnight.
Add 64 µl AMPure XP beads to each tube and perform bead cleanup.
Elute the ligated DNA in 34 µl ultra‑pure water.

steps.title: Fill‑in reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare fill‑in master mix, add 6 µl master mix to each sample, mix gently, incubate 20 min at 37 °C, clean with 64 µl AMPure XP beads per tube as per manufacturer’s instructions, and elute in 30 µl ultra‑pure water.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the fill‑in master mix for all samples.
Add 6 µl of master mix to each sample and mix gently.
Incubate the reaction for 20 min at 37 °C.
Add 64 µl AMPure XP beads to each tube and follow the bead‑cleanup protocol.
Elute the product in 30 µl ultra‑pure water.

steps.title: Indexed PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Perform indexed PCR amplification for 12 cycles, then clean the amplified library with 80 µl AMPure XP beads per tube, and elute in 30 µl ultra‑pure water.

substeps.instruction: Set up the indexed PCR reaction and run 12 cycles.
Add 80 µl AMPure XP beads to each tube and perform bead cleanup.
Elute the purified library in 30 µl ultra‑pure water.

steps.title: Quantify and pool libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify the libraries using a Nanodrop ND‑800, then pool them in equimolar ratios before Illumina sequencing.
